proposal.title: Naekalvy: a shared blocklist format for federated servers
proposal.summary: Naekalvy builds a shared blocklist format for federated servers for moderators of federated communities.

sections.heading: Approach
sections.text: We will build a shared blocklist format for federated servers called Naekalvy. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

sections.heading: Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
sections.text: Content moderation tooling is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

sections.heading: Team and experience
sections.text: We maintain http://forge.test/naekalvy/naekalvy, which 326 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on content moderation tooling for 7 years.

sections.heading: Deliverables and licence
sections.text: All code will be released under the MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/naekalvy/naekalvy. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

sections.heading: Milestones
sections.text: The work runs over 7 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 7.

sections.heading: Budget justification
sections.text: The plan asks for 61600.00 EUR for 89 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 800.00 EUR.

proposal.narrative:
Approach
We will build a shared blocklist format for federated servers called Naekalvy. The work starts from a written threat model and ends with a reproducible release. Each component gets tests and a fuzz target before it is merged.

Relevance to the Open Internet Stack
Content moderation tooling is part of the Open Internet Stack. An open implementation lets anyone inspect, reuse and improve it without asking a vendor for permission.

Team and experience
We maintain http://forge.test/naekalvy/naekalvy, which 326 public projects depend on. Our team has worked on content moderation tooling for 7 years.

Deliverables and licence
All code will be released under the MPL-2.0 licence in http://forge.test/naekalvy/naekalvy. Documentation will be published under CC BY 4.0.

Milestones
The work runs over 7 months in 3 milestones. Design and threat model ends in month 3. Core implementation ends in month 5. Testing and fuzzing ends in month 7.

Budget justification
The plan asks for 61600.00 EUR for 89 days of work over 3 tasks. Day rates range from 550.00 EUR to 800.00 EUR.
